crossRefs.note: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah…
So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria…
Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria came to him, and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.
The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”
So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant…
Now the men observed diligently, and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he…
Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.
Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.
Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for…

people.name: Ahaz
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jotham

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

people.name: Tiglath-pileser
people.line: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel

translations.web: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”
translations.bsb: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me from the hands of the kings of Aram and Israel, who are rising up against me.”
translations.kjv: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.
